methodology_note: Each objective's status is derived from executable artifacts (certification JSON, scenarios, module fingerprints, test results) not merely from filenames or prior prose. Dispositions: CERTIFIED / CERTIFIED_WITH_LIMITATION / DEFERRED / ENVIRONMENTAL_LIMITATION / ENHANCEMENT / BLOCKER.

objectives.title: Trustworthy mutation baseline + survivor taxonomy; no score chasing; deferred intelligence gated
objectives.original_intent: Establish a trustworthy mutation baseline and survivor taxonomy before any automatic test generation; pilot 4 engines; 12-component population authorized with 2 intelligence components explicitly deferred behind a test-strengthening gate.
objectives.implemented_capability: mutmut 3.7.0 pinned; explicit-pytest-path selection; R2 evidence-ordering fix; population-weighted aggregation rule; deferred components recorded as manifest entries not silently omitted.
objectives.executable_test_scenario: C42.21 pilot aggregate 81.8% population-weighted; 4 engines 2406 generated / 1965 killed; not_checked=0.
objectives.limitations: transaction_intelligence and financial_intelligence deferred (test-strengthening gate); population was 12 components at this milestone.
objectives.certification_impact: Foundational baseline; reused as authoritative evidence in C42.26 reconciliation.

objectives.title: Evidence-driven test strengthening & mutation gap closure with survivor classification
objectives.original_intent: Strengthen tests behaviorally based on survivor evidence (Class A-E); repair discovery defects in behaviour_engine and financial_events; no equivalent/artificially-killed mutants.
objectives.implemented_capability: Survivor classification framework (A/B/C/D/E); discovery-repair for behaviour_engine and financial_events; behavioral test strengthening plans; anti-gaming controls.
objectives.executable_test_scenario: Discovery repair PASS; behavioural strengthening IN_PROGRESS -> closed by C42.23; regression validation PASS.
objectives.certification_evidence: definition_of_done_checklist (28 items PASS); repository_mutation_certification NOT CERTIFIED at 49.9% (population incomplete).
objectives.limitations: Repository mutation certification NOT CERTIFIED at this milestone (49.9%, intelligence deferred). Phase workstream certified; this is expected progression not a blocker.
objectives.certification_impact: Introduced the Class A-E survivor taxonomy later hardened in C42.31.

objectives.title: Test-strengthening certification (batches) + anti-gaming controls
objectives.original_intent: Certify that strengthening batches produced genuine behavioral kills without weak/tautological assertions or equivalent-mutant targeting.
objectives.implemented_capability: 5 strengthening batches (cashflow, recommendation, common_calculations, credit_card, reconciliation, ledger); anti-gaming control list satisfied.
objectives.executable_test_scenario: cashflow 78 genuine kills (29.1%->74.4%); representative mutant spot-checks for other components.
objectives.limitations: Repository NOT CERTIFIED for mutation (intelligence deferred).
objectives.certification_impact: Validated strengthening causality required by C42.24 G4.

objectives.title: 10 exit gates; discovery integrity; 12-component population certified
objectives.original_intent: Pass 10 mandatory exit gates; close G3 discovery-integrity blocker via C42.24-B; certify 12-component population.
objectives.implemented_capability: 12-component population identity reconciliation; evidence completeness (not_checked==0); strengthening causality; deferred-intelligence decision.
objectives.executable_test_scenario: 10/10 gates PASS; final aggregate generated=11730, killed=5277, score=54.0%.
objectives.limitations: Both intelligence components remain NOT READY (deferred, not blocking 12-component certification).
objectives.certification_impact: 12-component authoritative campaign frozen (commit 6bb27a89) and later reused in C42.26.

objectives.title: Direct test suites for untested behaviour_engine modules; intelligence NOT READY
objectives.original_intent: Close G3 discovery-integrity blocker by building direct test suites for behaviour_engine's previously 0%-coverage modules (credit_dependency.py, temporal.py); keep intelligence components NOT READY.
objectives.implemented_capability: 61 direct tests for behaviour_engine modules; no_tests reduced 2835 -> 1955.
objectives.executable_test_scenario: G3 PASS; behaviour_engine +613 kills from new suites; not_checked==0 across 12 components.
objectives.certification_evidence: C42.24 G3 blocker_resolved; 12-component full campaign score=54.0%.
objectives.limitations: 1955 remaining no_tests in partially-covered modules (genuine behavioral gaps, not config defects).
objectives.certification_impact: 12-component population certified as authoritative measurement scope.

objectives.title: Intelligence components READY + CERTIFIED; enter mutation population
objectives.original_intent: Bring transaction_intelligence and financial_intelligence to READY (>=70% meaningful direct coverage, mutation smoke PASS, regression PASS) so they can enter the 14-component population.
objectives.implemented_capability: 157+20+5 unit/property/capability tests for transaction_intelligence (98.6% coverage); 245+22+6 for financial_intelligence (94.4% coverage); capability bindings; mutation smoke txn 70.2% / fin 73.0%.
objectives.executable_test_scenario: 14/14 gates PASS; Outcome A both READY; regression 529 tests PASS.
objectives.certification_evidence: gates G1-G14 PASS; mutation smoke txn/fin PASS with not_checked=0.
objectives.limitations: None blocking; this milestone specifically admits the components that C42.26 reconciles.

objectives.title: 14-component population reconciled; mathematically reconciled 60.297%; no full rerun required
objectives.original_intent: Certify 14-component population by evidence composition (C42.24-B 12-component + C42.25 2 intelligence) without a fresh full campaign; establish measurement cadence and evidence-reuse architecture.
objectives.implemented_capability: 14-component ledger; mathematically reconciled aggregate 9015/14951=60.297%; explicit AUTHORITATIVE/REUSED/DERIVED distinction; 20 DoD checks.
objectives.executable_test_scenario: 20/20 certification gates PASS; population 14; combined scored 14951 / killed 9015 / 60.297%.
objectives.limitations: 60.297% is mathematically reconciled, NOT an authoritative fresh full-campaign score (explicitly labelled).
objectives.certification_impact: Establishes the evidence-reuse baseline reused throughout C42.27-37.

objectives.title: Verification Graph + Planner hardening; deterministic planner
objectives.original_intent: Establish canonical VerificationGraph (sources/capabilities/surfaces/tasks); deterministic EvidenceAwarePlanner; evidence reuse + invalidation rules; CI evidence integration documented.
objectives.implemented_capability: graph_model.py (411 sources, 14 capabilities, 57 surfaces, 13 tasks, 59 edges); evidence_reuse.py (14 invalidation rules, 9 reuse dispositions); evidence_planner.py; correlation.py; scenarios A-E.
objectives.executable_test_scenario: 38 tests (test_m9_c42_27.py) 100% pass; 5/5 scenarios PASS; derived aggregate 60.297 matches C42.26.
objectives.limitations: CI evidence integration documented, not yet live-wired into workflows (C42.29/37 operational boundary).
objectives.certification_impact: Architectural foundation for all downstream targeted-verification phases.

objectives.title: Targeted verification execution & mutation plumbing; forensic records
objectives.original_intent: Implement executable plan contract; targeted mutation execution; evidence capture/reconciliation; scope enforcement; failure classification; forensic execution record.
objectives.implemented_capability: executor_pipeline.py (build_executable_plan, execute_mutation_task, scope guards); labelled aggregates (AUTHORITATIVE_MEASURED/AUTHORITATIVE_TARGETED/MATHEMATICALLY_RECONCILED); FailureKind taxonomy; forensic record.
objectives.executable_test_scenario: 24 tests PASS; 7/7 scenarios PASS (no_change, single_engine, test_only, new_component, scope_mismatch, verification_failure, infrastructure_failure); 92.86% cost avoided.
objectives.certification_impact: Proves targeted execution avoids 13/14 components without confidence loss.

objectives.title: CI evidence contract: emission schema, binding derivation, canonical conversion, semantic equivalence, failure taxonomy
objectives.original_intent: Define CIEvidenceRecord schema; deterministic binding derivation (COMMAND_MATCHERS); canonical conversion to ExecutionEvidence; 6-dimension semantic equivalence; distinguish CI verification vs infrastructure vs evidence failure.
objectives.implemented_capability: ci_evidence.py: CIEvidenceRecord (m9-ci-evidence/v1), build_ci_bindings, validate_and_decide, ingest_ci_evidence, semantic_equivalence, COMMAND_MATCHERS (14); classify_ci_failure precedence.
objectives.executable_test_scenario: 30 C42.29 tests PASS; scenarios CI-A..CI-H (8) all PASS; simulation with real mutation-summary.json.
objectives.limitations: Live workflow emission not wired (no CIEvidenceRecord emission step in mutation.yml/backend-verify.yml/frontend-verify.yml) -> ENVIRONMENTAL_LIMITATION / operational boundary, not architectural defect.
objectives.certification_impact: Unifies local+CI evidence model; emission path defined for post-certification.

objectives.title: Evidence invalidation/reuse determinism; planner scope determinism; full campaign only under formal gate
objectives.original_intent: Prove evidence invalidation is deterministic (R-SRC-001..R-POP etc.), reuse is deterministic, planner scope is deterministic, and a full campaign is triggered only by a formal gate (never by score/test-addition alone).
objectives.implemented_capability: validate_ci_evidence (8 drift categories), decide_reuse (13 rules); EvidenceAwarePlanner.plan deterministic; gate_full_campaign rejects score_improvement_desire / test_addition.
objectives.executable_test_scenario: 25 C42.30 tests PASS; scenarios FA..FH (8) all PASS; determinism_check_pass=true.
objectives.certification_evidence: scenarios (no_change, one_engine, test_change, config_change, ci_failure_distinction, discovery_drift, insufficient_test_surface, equivalent_nondeterministic).
objectives.limitations: Discovery-drift scenario correctly BLOCKS certification (expected behavior, not a defect).

objectives.title: Self-adaptive test loop: survivor classification, human authorization, targeted revalidation, repeated-survivor/Class-E escalation
objectives.original_intent: Implement the strengthening chain: survivor -> classification -> evidence-derived proposal -> human authorization boundary -> targeted revalidation -> regression check -> accept/reject; Class A-E handling; repeated-survivor escalation contract.
objectives.implemented_capability: strengthening.py: generate_proposal (Class A proposal / B/C/D/E rejection), evaluate_auto_approval_eligibility (approved always False), targeted_revalidation (zero-regression accept, used_full_campaign always False); master scenario with real survivor mut-cc-real-0047.
objectives.executable_test_scenario: 27 C42.31 tests PASS; master scenario 16 steps -> CERTIFIABLE; Class-A proposal accepted with zero regressions, used_full_campaign=false.
objectives.certification_evidence: final_certification=CERTIFIABLE; targeted_only=true; no_full_campaign=true; checks all true.
objectives.limitations: Class-E escalation THRESHOLD calibration deferred pending real historical data accumulation (DEFERRED_FOR_DATA).
objectives.certification_impact: Closes the human-authorization + autonomous-modification boundary required by global constraints #12/#13.

objectives.title: Forensic cache cannot bypass invalidation; cache correctness
objectives.original_intent: Prove the verification cache cannot turn a stored failure into a pass; forensic-aware cache key proposed with full invalidation rules.
objectives.implemented_capability: cache.py VerificationCache; forensic-cache-analysis demonstrates replay cannot return exit 0 for stored fail; forensic-aware key proposal.
objectives.executable_test_scenario: G15 (C42.32-36) PASS: cache replay cannot return exit 0 for stored fail.
objectives.limitations: Forensic-aware cache LAYER (wrapping with component-scoped fingerprints) is a recommended enhancement, not yet implemented.

objectives.title: Cross-engine impact bounded; shared-infrastructure gap identified
objectives.original_intent: Verify cross-engine impact from a single-engine change is correctly bounded; identify shared-infrastructure invalidation gap.
objectives.implemented_capability: cross-engine-impact.json validates single-engine change path; shared-infra gap (R-SRC-002 requires explicit shared:: prefix) documented.
objectives.executable_test_scenario: isolated_engine_change correctly bounded (1 selected, 13 excluded); shared_infra_change gap reproduced (0 affected, expected 4).
objectives.certification_evidence: G13 (C42.32-36) PASS with shared-infra gap tracked.
objectives.limitations: Shared-infra change detection requires explicit shared:: prefix (HIGH severity gap) -> ENHANCEMENT, non-blocking for single-engine scope.
objectives.certification_impact: Single-engine verification fully safe; shared-infra auto-detection deferred.

objectives.title: Repeated survivors can escalate (Class-E contract)
objectives.original_intent: Define Class-E escalation contract for repeated survivors; mechanism wired into diagnostic uncertainties.
objectives.implemented_capability: repeated-survivor-analysis.json defines CLASS-E ESCALATION contract + required evidence; wired into q8 uncertainties.
objectives.executable_test_scenario: G14 (C42.32-36) PASS: repeated survivors can escalate.
objectives.certification_evidence: CLASS-E ESCALATION contract defined; mechanism present in diagnostic agent.
objectives.limitations: Threshold conditions (observation_count>=3, independent_change_count>=2) proposed but require real historical accumulation for empirical validation -> DEFERRED_FOR_DATA.
objectives.certification_impact: Repeated-survivor handling is contractually defined and bounded.

objectives.title: Real repository master scenario passes end-to-end
objectives.original_intent: Execute a real repository master scenario (credit_card_engine/risk.py change) through the full pipeline to CERTIFIABLE.
objectives.implemented_capability: real-master-scenario pipeline: change -> graph -> capability -> invalidation -> reuse -> targeted execution -> CI correlation -> survivor classification -> diagnostic -> strengthening -> targeted validation -> certification.
objectives.executable_test_scenario: real-master-scenario-full.json: complete=true, missing=[], silently_empty=[]; 16-step pipeline -> CERTIFIABLE; 440 killed, 75.6%.
objectives.certification_evidence: G16/G25 (C42.32-36) PASS; forensic record self-contained with 12 stages.

objectives.title: Full convergence decision: 26/26 gates certifiable
objectives.original_intent: Final convergence across C42.29-36: 26 gates; certifiable verdict; no full campaign required.
objectives.implemented_capability: 26-gate certification harness; campaign governance; program completeness; autonomy boundary.
objectives.limitations: None blocking; several items carried as non-blocking limitations (shared-infra, cache layer, Class-E calibration).
objectives.certification_impact: Establishes C42.29-36 as certifiable baseline for C42.37/38.

objectives.title: Final verification system certification; workflow audit; CI emission boundary; forensic cache
objectives.original_intent: Audit the complete certified architecture; 13 workflows matched against COMMAND_MATCHERS; CI live-emission boundary identified; forensic cache; self-adaptive boundary; repository acceptance (14 scenarios); resource efficiency; readiness (18/20 YES, 2 PARTIALLY).
objectives.implemented_capability: 14 certification artifacts; workflow-verification-matrix (13 workflows, 18 steps); ci-live-emission-certification; self-adaptive-test-certification; repository-acceptance-matrix (14 scenarios); resource-efficiency; final-readiness-audit.
objectives.executable_test_scenario: 82 C42.29-31 tests PASS; 27 scenarios PASS; 12 master acceptance checks PASS; readiness 18 YES / 2 PARTIALLY / 0 NO.
objectives.limitations: Live CI emission (ENVIRONMENTAL_LIMITATION); shared-infra auto-detection (ENHANCEMENT); Class-E calibration (DEFERRED_FOR_DATA); forensic-aware cache (ENHANCEMENT); SurvivorRegistry (ENHANCEMENT).

summary.note: C42.22/23/24 milestones show repository mutation NOT CERTIFIED at their own time because the population was incomplete; this is expected progression, not a residual blocker, since C42.26 completed the 14-component population.
